title: Negated path clause
statement: For a path on $n$ Boolean coordinates, form a term from the path's literals by negating each literal. The resulting term has no repeated coordinate indices.
caveat: The definitions of the path-to-literals construction and literal negation are not included, so their precise sign conventions cannot be stated.
